ja253:1.1: For me extensive and rich food and drinks
ja253:1.2: Are available because of this jewel,
ja253:1.3: I won’t give it to you, you ask too much,
ja253:1.4: Nor will I come back to your hermitage.
ja253:2.1: Like a boy with a sharpened sword in hand,
ja253:2.2: You scare me as you beg for this sapphire,
ja253:2.3: I won’t give it to you, you ask too much,
ja253:2.4: Nor will I come back to your hermitage.
ja253:3.1: You shouldn’t beg or desire what he holds dear,
ja253:3.2: Through excessive begging he is detested,
ja253:3.3: The Nāga, whose jewel the brahmin begged,
ja253:3.4: Went away and he was surely not seen.
